include(FetchContent)

FetchContent_Declare(tracy
    URL https://codeload.github.com/wolfpld/tracy/tar.gz/refs/tags/v0.15.0
    URL_HASH SHA256=3d57da54aa67d7875da1e8fecd0bd5957675cef73c27dd52bffb6ab8d290a5e6
    DOWNLOAD_EXTRACT_TIMESTAMP TRUE
    SOURCE_SUBDIR unused)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(tracy)

set(TRACY_ENABLE ON)
set(TRACY_STATIC OFF)
set(TRACY_ON_DEMAND ON)
set(TRACY_ONLY_LOCALHOST ON)
set(TRACY_ONLY_IPV4 ON)
set(TRACY_NO_BROADCAST ON)
set(TRACY_NO_CODE_TRANSFER ON)
set(TRACY_NO_SYSTEM_TRACING ON)
set(TRACY_NO_CALLSTACK ON)
set(TRACY_NO_FRAME_IMAGE ON)
set(TRACY_NO_CRASH_HANDLER ON)
set(TRACY_TIMER_FALLBACK ON)
add_subdirectory("${tracy_SOURCE_DIR}" "${tracy_BINARY_DIR}" EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)

install(TARGETS TracyClient
    LIBRARY DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_LIB_DIR}" COMPONENT Runtime NAMELINK_SKIP
    RUNTIME DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_LIB_DIR}" COMPONENT Runtime)
install(FILES "${tracy_SOURCE_DIR}/LICENSE"
    DESTINATION "${POLOS_INSTALL_DIR}" RENAME LICENSE-Tracy.txt COMPONENT Runtime)
